actual_scope: Exclude irreducible five-dimensional complete binary rank-one-idempotent pools for three-dimensional off-diagonal pattern spaces containing exactly one matrix-unit edge.

stop_rule: Stop after the first verified exclusion, a complete reducible equality example and bounded exact corroboration; do not extend to lower-dimensional word cases.
evidence: PROOF.md gives the new all-ambient-width implication using the cited edge-quotient premise. verify.py checks a complete equality fixture, seven negative controls, and all relevant fixed-edge spaces at widths five and six.
